target_customer: AI teams that self host models and pay for GPUs
problem: Default serving engines such as vLLM and SGLang are tuned for the average workload, so most deployments waste GPU throughput and money.
business_model: Performance based service: custom deployment images, pay only if the agreed performance target is met

founders.name: Zakaria El hjouji
previous_startups: Built and sold a software product during grad school at MIT
founders.background_notes: Seven years on pricing algorithms at Uber and GPU kernels at Meta AI per YC page.

founders.name: Younes El hjouji
founders.background_notes: Computer vision AI frameworks engineer at Intel; described as Zakaria's cousin in one source and brother in others.

competitors.name: Together AI and Fireworks AI
competitors.what: General inference platforms that host and optimize models

competitors.name: Roboflow
competitors.what: Computer vision inference platform (relevant to the earlier real-time vision product)

technical_complexity.rationale: Custom attention kernels and workload specific tuning on modern GPUs require deep systems skill; the website cites a kernel speedup from 1,770 ms to 464 ms on one benchmark (company claim).

defensibility.rationale: Services style optimization is skill dependent and replicable by larger inference vendors who optimize their own stacks.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent response recorded yet; a third party tier list warns that general platforms erode latency advantages.

market_need_then: Inference cost is a major spend for AI teams; the CEO claims the company saved customers over $5 million in deployments (unverified, from a post on X reported by one outlet).

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct performance claims and pay only if targets are met

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself; the name is an engineering term (overshoot) and the site references BlueCream without explanation.

pivots.from: Real-time vision API for video agents (YC launch post: fastest API for real-time vision)
pivots.to: Custom inference stack optimization for AI teams
pivots.why: Not stated; the website now positions the company around inference optimization

outcome_analysis: Overshoot is an active Winter 2026 company with no disclosed round, though one aggregator lists a March 2026 seed led by Pioneer Fund. It appears to have moved from a real-time vision API to selling performance guaranteed inference optimization. No outcome yet; main risks are a services heavy model and larger inference vendors closing the gap.
notes: Unverified: Preqin (single aggregator) shows a seed on 2026-03-19 led by Pioneer Fund with undisclosed amount; not recorded as a round. Team size conflicts (YC lists 5, directory lists 2). Competitor sources are a tier list dated 2026 without exact dates. Pivot dates unknown. Founder relationship reported inconsistently. Completeness pass: the seed dated 2026-03-19 with undisclosed amount rests on a single database (Preqin); VCBacked and Neuronfeed list 500K total with conflicting stage and date.
